high_level_description: A small neighbourhood corner shop in Mexico City with a cheerful shopkeeper in his sixties behind the counter, shelves of colourful snacks and drinks behind him.

style_description.aesthetics: Warm, inviting vintage travel-poster illustration of Mexico City; simple confident shapes, gentle grain, uncluttered composition, no lettering, no signs with words, no captions, no user interface.
style_description.lighting: Bright high-altitude sunlight with soft warm shadows.
style_description.art_style: Mid-century gouache travel poster with flat layered shapes, visible brush texture and a limited warm palette.

compositional_deconstruction.background: The open front of a little shop on a street corner, its walls painted bright yellow, with a hand-painted awning and no readable words.

elements.desc: A cheerful round-faced man of about sixty-five with grey hair, glasses and an apron over a checked shirt, leaning on the counter and smiling.
Shelves packed with colourful bottles of soft drinks, bags of crisps, loaves of bread and sweets, with no readable labels.
A wooden counter with a glass jar of sweets and a small basket of bread rolls.
Stacked crates of glass bottles beside the counter.
